channel.title: Marketing & Sales Software — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched software reviews: real pricing, the catch and who should skip it.

item.title: BSS B2B Lock Review (2026): Hide Prices
item.description: BSS B2B Lock, Free plan: lock the entire website by condition, free setup help from BSS support. Hiding prices needs a paid plan.

item.title: Cartly Review (2026): Cart Drawer, Free to 20 Orders
item.description: Cartly: Free for the first 20 lifetime orders. The price follows your orders: $16.99 a month up to 100 orders, $49.99 for 301 to 750 and $199.99 above 5,000.

item.title: BSS B2B Solution Review (2026): Wholesale Pricing
item.description: BSS B2B Solution: Essential is $29 a month or $313.20 a year. The free plan covers only 1 custom pricing rule and 1 registration form on live stores.

item.title: KudosCRM Review (2026): Free CRM, Paid From $9 a Seat
item.description: KudosCRM: Basic costs $9 per seat a month billed yearly or $12 monthly. The Free plan allows 1 pipeline and 3 seats.

item.title: Social Snowball Review (2026): Shopify Affiliates, From $249
item.description: Social Snowball, Snow Day: $249 a month plus 3% of affiliate revenue. One merchant review from 10 November 2026 says the affiliate side is English only.

item.title: Langwill Review (2026): Shopify Translation, Free to $49.99
item.description: Langwill, Free: 5,000 words, 1 translated language, 153 currencies, multilingual SEO. Auto-translate and image translation need Growth.

item.title: Systeme.io Review (Tested Nov 2026): Free to 2,000 Contacts
item.description: Systeme.io, Free $0: 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels with 15 funnel steps, 1 website, 1 blog, 1 course, 1 affiliate program. Plans are metered on contacts.

item.title: Seobility Review (2026): Free Account, Premium 59.90 EUR a Month
item.description: Seobility, Basic: free, no time limit, 1 project, 10 keywords, 100 pages per crawl, limited website audit, 5 daily tool credits, 3 tracked AI prompts.

item.title: Rewardful Review (2026): Affiliate Tracking for Stripe, From $49
item.description: Rewardful: Enterprise from $149 a month or $1,490 a year (up to $30,000 on the entry tier). Starter gives only 1 campaign and no branded portal.

item.title: PageFly Review (Tested): Free Plan, Paid From $24 a Month
item.description: PageFly: $0, 1 published page or section, 10 AI credits a month, 320+ templates, demo dashboard, no card. The price depends on how many pages you publish.

item.title: My Stories Review (Tested): Shopify Video Stories, From $14
item.description: My Stories, Beginner: $0, up to 10 uploaded videos, unlimited views, shoppable videos, watermark. Lead capture is capped at 20 a month on the $14 plan.

item.title: Klap Review (Tested): Long Videos to Shorts, From $14.50
item.description: Klap, Basic: 100 clips a month, $14.50 a month billed yearly ($174 a year) or $29 month to month. The cheap price is the yearly one.

item.title: EmailOctopus Review (2026): Free to 2,500 Subscribers, Pro $9
item.description: EmailOctopus: $20 a month, or $18 a month billed yearly ($216 a year), for 1,001 to 2,500 subscribers and 25,000 emails. The price grows with your list.

item.title: RepointQR Review (2026): Editable QR Codes From $9.99
item.description: RepointQR makes editable dynamic QR codes. Free codes send scans through a RepointQR branded redirect page.

item.title: Essential Cart Drawer Review (Tested): Free to 30 Orders
item.description: Essential Cart Drawer: Free is $0 for up to 30 orders. The price follows drawer orders, so a store that sells well through the cart moves up the ladder.

item.title: VoiceDrop Review (2026): Ringless Voicemail From $95 a Month
item.description: VoiceDrop sells ringless voicemail by usage units. The callback rates on the page are the vendor's own and cannot be checked.

item.title: BeSure Checkout Rules Review (2026): $4.99 to $29.99, Tested
item.description: BeSure Checkout Rules has a Free plan that lets you test rules in testing status and works on Shopify development stores.

item.title: OptinMonster Review (2026): Popups and Lead Capture for Websites
item.description: OptinMonster: Basic is $108 billed today and renews at $210 a year, for 1 site and 2,500 campaign impressions. The first-year price is a discount.

item.title: All in One SEO Review (2026): WordPress SEO Plugin
item.description: All in One SEO sells four yearly plans. The first-year price is half the regular price and every renewal is at full price.

item.title: ShopTrueProfit Review (2026): Profit Reports for Etsy Sellers
item.description: ShopTrueProfit: Free costs $0 and gives a full sample-data demo, your latest month, the Etsy, eBay and Amazon fee calculators.

item.title: MailVeri Review (2026): Bulk Email Verification, Pay as You Go
item.description: MailVeri sells pay-as-you-go credit packs with no subscription. The accuracy and savings figures come from MailVeri’s own pricing page and comparison tables.

item.title: Cloze CRM Review (Tested): Email-First CRM for Small Teams
item.description: Cloze CRM: Cloze has four paid plans and a 14 day free trial with no credit card. The pricing page does not name the currency and shows no free plan limits.

item.title: AI Autocomplete Review (2026): Filter Suggestions in Shopify
item.description: AI Autocomplete has two plans, both with a 30-day free trial. Usage charges sit on top of the monthly fee and the listing does not define a prediction.

item.title: AddressHero Review (2026): Address Checks, Tested Nov 2026
item.description: AddressHero sells three plans for Shopify stores, each with a 14-day free trial. Lite does not validate against address databases or correct automatically.

item.title: Ship.com Review (2026): Discounted Shipping Labels for Sellers
item.description: Ship.com: Growth costs $19.99 a month, or $14 a month on the yearly toggle. Postage is billed on top of every plan, the pricing page shows no postage rates.

item.title: LinkShortener.io Review (2026): Branded Short Links and QR Codes
item.description: LinkShortener.io: Free costs $0 for 20 a month on the shared tli.sh domain and needs an account but no card.

item.title: eReleases Review (2026): Press Release Distribution Service
item.description: eReleases: Buzz Builder costs $399 and covers 400 words and 1 industry target list. Add-ons cost $150 or more each, the page shows no refund terms.

item.title: RankSlide Review (2026): Search Console Drop Alerts, $48 a Year
item.description: RankSlide: Pro covers 5 sites for $106 a year, shown as $8.83 a month. The page text shows no refund or cancellation terms.

item.title: P2COS Review (2026): Local-First Prospecting and CRM Desktop App
item.description: P2COS: Annual standard prices are $199.99, $399.99 and $699.99. The software needs a paid licence, and several support features are listed as coming soon.

item.title: Kedra AI Index Review (Tested): AI Visibility for Shopify Stores
item.description: Kedra AI Index: Kedra has a Free plan and three paid plans. It works only on Shopify, and the visibility results come from the vendor's own tests.
